note: Quick Node Block provides one block plugin, id quick_node_block (category 'Quick Node Block'), that renders a chosen node in a chosen view mode. Config is per placed block: settings.quick_node ('Title (nid)') and settings.quick_display (view mode). No global config page. Local task 'Add to Block' at admin/node/{node}/quick_node_block (permission 'administer blocks'). Medium introspection places a block configured with a known node + teaser view mode and the agent reports the view mode; hard execution has the agent place a Quick Node Block rendering a fixture node in the 'full' view mode, verified against the live block config. Fixtures create their own namespaced node (qnb_*) and block, and remove them in cleanup.

evals.prompt: What does the quick_node_block module add, and what two things do you configure on it when you place it in a region?
evals.expected_output: It adds a single block plugin (id quick_node_block, category 'Quick Node Block') that renders one node. When placing it you choose a Node (entity autocomplete) and a Display / view mode; these are saved as the block settings quick_node ('Title (nid)') and quick_display.

evals.prompt: Does quick_node_block have a central admin settings page? Where does its configuration actually live, and how is the rendered node kept up to date and access-controlled?
evals.expected_output: No global settings page (configure is null). All config lives on each placed block (settings.quick_node, settings.quick_display). The block renders via the node view builder, defers to the node's 'view' access in blockAccess(), and adds a node:<nid> cache tag so it refreshes when the node changes.

evals.prompt: quick_node_block adds a convenience tab on node pages to place that node in a block. What is the tab called, its route path, and what permission does it need?
evals.expected_output: The 'Add to Block' local task at admin/node/{node}/quick_node_block (route quick_node_block.quickadd) requires the 'administer blocks' permission; it opens the block-add form pre-filled with that node.

evals.prompt: On this site a Quick Node Block has been placed (block id qnb_known_block). Inspect the live block configuration and state which node view mode (display) it is set to render.
evals.expected_output: The block block.block.qnb_known_block has settings.quick_display = teaser (and settings.quick_node points at the QNB Known node). drush cget block.block.qnb_known_block settings.

evals.prompt: This site has an article titled 'QNB Sample'. Using the quick_node_block module, place a Quick Node Block (in the default theme) that renders that node using the 'full' view mode. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A block config entity with plugin quick_node_block exists whose settings.quick_display === 'full' and whose settings.quick_node references the QNB Sample node's nid (e.g. 'QNB Sample (N)'). Placed via Block layout or Block::create([...])->save().

evals.prompt: On this site a Quick Node Block has been placed (block id qnb_known_node_block). Inspect the live block configuration and report the title of the node it is configured to render.
evals.expected_output: The block block.block.qnb_known_node_block has settings.quick_node = 'QNB Featured Item (N)', i.e. it renders the node titled 'QNB Featured Item' (drush cget block.block.qnb_known_node_block settings.quick_node).

evals.prompt: This site has an article titled 'QNB Sample Two'. Using the quick_node_block module, place a Quick Node Block (in the default theme) that renders that node using the 'teaser' view mode. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A block config entity with plugin quick_node_block exists whose settings.quick_display === 'teaser' and whose settings.quick_node references the QNB Sample Two node's nid.
